title: Running Median
statement:
Given a stream of N integers, after inserting each new integer print the current median of all inserted integers.

The median is:
- The middle value if the count is odd.
- The average of the two middle values if the count is even. Print it as X.5 if it is not a whole number.

Use two heaps: a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers (in insertion order).
outputFormat: N lines, the i-th line is the median after inserting the first i elements.

examples.explanation: After [5]: median=5. After [5,15]: median=10. After [1,5,15]: median=5. After [1,3,5,15]: median=4.
